Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.controller

Class GameControllerImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.controller.GameControllerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChatController, GameController
public class GameControllerImpl extends Object implements GameController, ChatController
It allows to do the basic moves of the game, disconnect from a game, add the observers and is responsible for signaling the end turn and end game.
